material.narrative: [page-copy-preserves-every-byte: fail] The kernel divides byte size by eight after reinterpreting every tensor as int64; 2 odd-byte cases disagree with the byte oracle. [asynchronous-metadata-outlives-kernel-consumption: fail] A delayed current-stream launch consumed the mapping written by the next request, while the old per-copy path retained the intended mapping. [zero-work-launch-is-guarded: fail] The exact head source has no num_blocks == 0 guard. [performance-direction-is-measured-not-assumed: pass] At one mapping the candidate speedup is 0.920x; at 256 mappings it is 41.36x. The optimization direction is valuable but does not override correctness failures. observations.conclusion: The kernel divides byte size by eight after reinterpreting every tensor as int64; 2 odd-byte cases disagree with the byte oracle.
counterevidence: Aligned 256-byte FP16 pages match the oracle.
observations.question: Does the fused page copy preserve tensor pages not divisible by eight bytes?

observations.conclusion: A delayed current-stream launch consumed the mapping written by the next request, while the old per-copy path retained the intended mapping.
